mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization path: Taiwan notary public notarization -> Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification -> PRC cross-strait notarial authentication; Hague Apostille path is not available and must not be chained because Taiwan, China is not an Apostille Convention contracting party.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and Blocked Persons List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, PRC Ministry of Public Security databases, SAMR blacklists, and commercial PEP/adverse-media databases. PEP status triggers escalated senior-management approval, source-of-wealth verification, and enhanced ongoing monitoring. Screening must be repeated within 48 hours of sanctions list updates and periodically thereafter. Results, risk ratings, and EDD files must be retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Name Registration System of the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (www.gsxt.gov.cn) and local SAMR online service windows
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE statutory name must be in simplified Chinese characters in a four-tier sequence: administrative division + distinctive name + industry/operating characteristic + company type (e.g., Co., Ltd.). Pinyin, English, or other transliteration cannot replace the Chinese statutory name. The industry component must match the approved business scope, and any English name should be a non-binding supplementary transliteration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If SAMR rejects a proposed name, the applicant receives a written electronic notice stating legal grounds. Within 60 days from the rejection decision, the applicant may file written administrative reconsideration with the next-higher Administration for Market Regulation, or within 6 months may initiate administrative litigation in the competent people's court. The appeal should include a revised name, a legal comparison chart against identical/similar names, evidence of prior trademark rights if applicable, and consent letters from prior name holders if obtained. Counsel must submit the appeal through the local SAMR service window and retain time-stamped submission receipts.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible as the WFOE's sole registered address for surgical suture and needle assembly. Local SAMR, tax authorities, the National Medical Products Administration, customs, and banks require an actual physical production facility, lease agreement, equipment, employees, and business records. A virtual office fails the commercial substance test under PRC business registration and tax rules, and will trigger rejection of invoice limits, denial of export VAT rebates, inability to obtain the medical device production license, and refusal to open a corporate bank account.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: approximately 80% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months by SAMR, tax, fire safety, or environmental protection authorities. Checklist for inspection readiness: readable company name plate at the registered address; original lease and property certificate; production equipment and raw materials; attendance and labor contracts; fire safety and environmental permits; NMPA medical device production license; accounting books, invoices, contracts, and customs records; consistency of all operational indicators with the registered address; and health and safety signage.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act, R.O.C. (Taiwan) §§ 98–115 (limited-company formation and shareholder contribution), §§ 387–398 (company registration); Foreign Investors Act §§ 3 and 6–12; Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area §§ 73 and 93 (special review applicable to mainland-based investors).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) — Company One-Stop Integrated Registration Portal; for Taipei-based registered offices, administrative registration is handled through the Taipei City Government Business Registration Department.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (公司章程), Application for Company Registration (公司設立登記申請書), and First Board / Sole Shareholder Resolution (股東同意書暨董事會議事錄).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Taiwan imposes no statutory minimum paid-in capital for a limited company; however, the full subscribed capital must be deposited into a purpose-designated capital escrow bank account, evidenced by a bank balance certificate, and verified by a licensed CPA before registration. For a surgical-suture needle plant, prudent underwriting and TFDA QMS/GMP inspection will require board-committed paid-in capital of at least USD 200,000 equivalent (approx. NT$6,200,000) to fund cleanroom fit-out, ethylene-oxide sterilizer installation, and the QC laboratory.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the founding shareholder ratifies the incorporation of the Company under the Company Act and files the statutory registration dossier with the Department of Commerce, MOEA. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the entire stated paid-in capital of USD ______ / NT$ ______ be subscribed, fully deposited in the Company's capital escrow account at ______ Bank, and verified by the appointed CPA. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at ______, Taipei, Taiwan, R.O.C. FURTHER RESOLVED, that ______ be appointed lawful Director/Representative, with ______ as Finance Officer and ______ as Plant Manager, each invested with authority to open bank accounts, execute corporate filings, and apply for the medical-device manufacturer's license and factory registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce — Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval Service (公司名稱及所營事業預查), accessible via the MOEA One-Stop Integrated Company Registration Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the MOEA One-Stop Portal and apply for name pre-approval proposing both a Chinese legal name (e.g., 台灣愛博可吸收縫線股份有限公司) and an English company name; declare the exact business scope referencing ISIC 3250 medical-device manufacturing. Obtain the name pre-approval certificate, which is valid for six months and must be used in the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Passport / national-ID copies of the founding shareholder and first director
Proposed Chinese and English company names
Exact business-scope text in Chinese (medical-device manufacturing, e.g., 醫療器材製造業)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected for similarity with an existing registration or trademark, file an amended application with two alternative names within five business days; a supplemental trademark search may be required before re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部投資審議委員會).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Foreign Investment Application designating the Chinese parent (CN_WFOE_LTD) as sole investing shareholder, furnishing audited financial statements, a manufacturing business plan, and a capitalization schedule. Because the investor is mainland-based, the Investment Commission shall conduct a special review under the Mainland Investment Regulations; the issuance of an Investment Approval Certificate must precede capital remittance.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and audited financial statements of the investing parent
Power of attorney executed by the parent
Manufacturing business plan with ISIC 3250 project narrative
Capital remittance schedule and source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is questioned on cross-strait restriction grounds, submit a supplemental letter with evidence of the permitted medical-device manufacturing classification and an export-market plan within 30 days; an administrative appeal to the Executive Yuan remains available.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Escrow Account Opening and Capital Remittance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed foreign-exchange bank and Central Bank of China (Taiwan) foreign-exchange monitoring system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary company-in-formation escrow account in the proposed legal name of the entity; deposit the full subscribed paid-in capital by T/T remittance from the parent company; obtain the bank's capital balance certificate (存款餘額證明) and file the inward remittance with the Central Bank on the applicable foreign-exchange report form. The escrow account must be converted into the operational corporate account immediately after registration.
required_dossiers: Bank account application and seal-card forms
AML/KYC questionnaire and ultimate beneficial ownership chart
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank suspends the remittance for KYC/AML queries, provide updated UBO documentation, parent-board resolutions, and audited financials; the remittance may be re-routed to an alternative authorized FX bank within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: CPA Capital Verification and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed CPA (會計師) registered under the Certified Public Accountant Act of Taiwan; local notary office where signature verification is required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed CPA to verify the escrow balance certificate against the company ledger and issue the Capital Verification Report; execute the Articles of Incorporation before the organizing shareholder and first director; notarize the signatures if required by the Registry or the bank, and secure the corporate seal (公司大小章).
required_dossiers: Capital Verification Report of the CPA
First Board / Sole Shareholder Resolution for capital subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CPA questions the source of funds, produce intercompany equity Agreements and audited parent financials; amend the Articles on share-transfer restrictions and pledge provisions to satisfy the CPA's reservations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Registration and Issuance of Company Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce / Taipei City Government Integrated Company Registration Window (一站式公司登記服務).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation dossier through the One-Stop Portal, including the Articles, shareholder/director consents, CPA capital verification report, proof of the registered office lease, and payment of the registration fee; receive the incorporation registration certificate and the Unified Business Number (統一編號).
required_dossiers: Registered-office lease agreement and landlord's building-use consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a corrective notice (補正通知), cure all referenced deficiencies within 15 days; if the lease use-consent is questioned for industrial zoning, apply for a building-use-change approval from the Municipal Construction Bureau before re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Tax and Uniform Invoice (VAT) Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the registered jurisdiction, Ministry of Finance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete tax registration (稅籍登記) within 30 days after incorporation; apply for uniform invoice registration for VAT purposes and register the business for electronic invoice issuance; obtain the tax registration certificate linked to the Unified Business Number and the company seal card.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax bureau flags a mismatch between the declared business scope and actual manufacturing activity, file a supplementary scope amendment and an explanatory letter; late-filing penalties may be mitigated through a voluntary disclosure filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Factory Registration, TFDA Medical Device Manufacturer License, and Environmental Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Industrial Development Bureau, MOEA and Municipal Economic Development Department (factory registration); Food and Drug Administration (TFDA), Ministry of Health and Welfare (medical device manufacturer license); Ministry of Environment / local EPA bureau (environmental clearance).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For the manufacturing plant, apply for Factory Registration (工廠登記) and the TFDA Medical Devices Manufacturer License (醫療器材製造商許可執照) under the Medical Devices Management Act, completing the QMS/GMP audit; simultaneously file the Waste Disposal Operating Plan and water-pollution self-monitoring registration with the local EPA bureau; obtain the fire-safety certificate and building-use approval for the cleanroom, ethylene-oxide sterilizer, and assembly lines.
required_dossiers: Factory registration application and plant layout plan
Building-use license and structural load certificate
QMS/GMP manual and sterilization validation protocol for suture needles
Waste Disposal Operating Plan and wastewater connection permit application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the factory license is suspended due to QMS findings, submit a corrective-and-preventive-action (CAPA) plan within 60 days with re-validation evidence; a provisional factory registration may be issued for pilot production while final QMS audit findings are cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Import/Export Registration and Foreign-Exchange Compliance Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bureau of Foreign Trade (BOFT), MOEA; Central Bank of China (Taiwan) foreign-exchange statistics reporting unit.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Exporter/Importer Registration (出進口廠商登記) to obtain the trade registration code for customs purposes; update the Central Bank's foreign-exchange file reflecting the equity remittance and future repatriation of dividends through Swift_LC / TT_Wire rails; register authorized banking signatories for import settlement of raw materials and machinery.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney for trade representatives
Customs commodity classification for surgical suture needles (HS 9018.39) and raw-material inputs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If BOFT flags the English company name as inconsistent with customs records, file a name-correction amendment with the incorporation registry before re-registration; foreign-exchange reporting irregularities are cured by filing a supplementary wire report with the Central Bank.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Food and Drug Administration (TFDA), Ministry of Health and Welfare — Medical Device Division (QMS/GMP audit and manufacturer license); Industrial Development Bureau, MOEA — factory registration, industrial zoning, and plant approval.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Devices Manufacturer License (醫療器材製造商許可執照), Factory Registration Certificate (工廠登記證), and ISO 13485 / QMS (GMP) certification where applicable.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment (MOENV), Taiwan R.O.C. (行政院環境保護署 reorganized as 環境部 effective August 2023), including the local municipal environmental protection bureau.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Because the plant performs clean-medical-device assembly without foundry, coating, plating, or large-capacity boiler operations above the promulgated thresholds, the project is classified outside the mandatory full-EIA category table and treated as a low-impact registration / exemption category. Nonetheless, the operator must file a Waste Disposal Operating Plan (廢棄物清理計畫書) and a wastewater self-monitoring registration for cleanroom rinse water and sterilizer cooling water.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Effluent discharged to a municipal sewer shall meet the Taiwan Effluent Standards (放流水標準) under the Water Pollution Control Act: pH 6–9, BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L, COD ≤ 100 mg/L, and SS ≤ 30 mg/L, or the municipal sewer pre-treatment thresholds if higher. VOC-emitting degreasing cabinets (acetone/isopropanol wash) shall be enclosed with solvent recovery or activated-carbon controls achieving ≥ 90% removal efficiency; ethylene-oxide sterilizer exhaust shall be controlled to ≤ 250 mg/m³ at the stack and the workplace exposure maintained at ≤ 1 ppm TWA (8-hour) per the Taiwan occupational permissible exposure levels. Biomedical solid waste (needles, sharps, contaminated packaging) shall be handled only through a licensed medical-waste transporter under a manifest system (聯單) and incinerated at an approved medical-waste treatment facility.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: installation, inspection, and annual maintenance declaration (消防安全設備檢修申報) certified by the local Fire Bureau; structural and building-use clearance: a building-use license (使用執照) issued by the Municipal Construction Authority verifying floor loads, exit capacity, and cleanroom occupancy classification; occupational safety and health clearance: submission of a job-hazard assessment, ethylene-oxide medical surveillance program, solvent storage explosion-protection dossier, emergency evacuation plan, and PPE program acceptable to the local labor inspection office before plant commissioning.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (国家税务总局, STA) of the People's Republic of China; official national portal www.chinatax.gov.cn and the Electronic Tax Bureau (电子税务局, https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn), integrated with the China International Trade Single Window (国际贸易单一窗口) and SAFE. The Taiwan-invested WFOE is a PRC resident taxpayer registered under the EIT Law and the Law on the Protection of Investments by Taiwanese Compatriots. Following the 2018 merger of state and local tax administrations, STA bureaus administer nationally, while VAT and EIT revenues remain shared between the central and local governments (50:50 for VAT; 60:40 for EIT).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Register the WFOE with the local Administration for Market Regulation to obtain the business license carrying the statutory 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (统一社会信用代码, USCC), which functions as the taxpayer identification number (纳税人识别号). (2) The 'multi-license integration' (多证合一) system automatically populates the tax registration in the STA database upon license issuance. (3) Complete real-name tax filing verification (实名办税认证) for the legal representative, financial officer, and tax filer via the Electronic Tax Bureau with facial recognition. (4) Within 30 days, file the tax information confirmation, accounting system filing, bank account report, and VAT general taxpayer registration through the Electronic Tax Bureau. (5) Apply for invoice type and maximum-invoice-limit consent, export tax refund filing (出口退（免）税备案), SAFE trade foreign-exchange registry inclusion, and any relevant medical device export certification (NMPA Certificate for Export Sales of Medical Devices) required for customs clearance of the surgical suture product.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists in China. Applicable statutory elections: (i) VAT taxpayer status election between general taxpayer (一般纳税人) and small-scale taxpayer (小规模纳税人) where annual sales are below RMB 5,000,000; (ii) hybrid investment election under STA Bulletin 2013 No. 41 permitting characterization of qualifying hybrid instruments as debt (deductible interest) or equity (non-deductible dividends); (iii) Small Low-Profit Enterprise election delivering a 5% effective EIT rate on taxable income up to RMB 3,000,000 with the reduced 20% rate; (iv) High and New Technology Enterprise certification election for the 15% EIT rate; and (v) profits-reinvestment deferral election by a foreign (including Taiwan) investor under MOF/STA Bulletin 2018 No. 102 deferring 10% withholding tax where after-tax profits are directly reinvested in the WFOE.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (增值税, VAT) under the Provisional Regulations on VAT and implemented through Golden Tax Phase IV; the new VAT Law (中华人民共和国增值税法) promulgated on 25 December 2024 will supersede the provisional regime on 1 January 2026.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Registration is mandatory for all sellers of taxable goods/services with no de minimis VAT registration threshold. General taxpayer registration becomes mandatory once annual sales exceed RMB 5,000,000; below this threshold, small-scale status may be retained (generally 3% collection rate, currently reduced to 1% through 31 December 2027), and small-scale taxpayers benefit from a monthly sales exemption of RMB 100,000 (quarterly RMB 300,000). An exporting manufacturer such as the WFOE should elect general taxpayer status to utilize input-VAT credits and export refunds.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoices (数电票) are mandated for all newly established enterprises under Golden Tax Phase IV, issued through the national Unified Invoice Service Platform on the Electronic Tax Bureau. Each e-invoice carries a unique 20-digit invoice number and a cryptographic digital authentication (税务数字证书), is uploaded to the STA database in real time at issuance, undergoes centralized invoice/rationality clearance matching (发票稽核比对) against customs, VAT offset, and bank data, and does not require a physical stamp. Issuance is available via the government portal, mobile app, or enterprise ERP/API interfaces; legacy paper special VAT invoices apply only to pre-existing conversion arrangements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The manufacturing WFOE may claim the 0% export VAT rate and refund through the 'exempt, offset, refund' (免抵退) method if: (1) it is a registered VAT general taxpayer; (2) the surgical suture needles are manufactured by the WFOE, physically exported, declared to GACC, and leave the PRC customs territory; (3) export proceeds are received in foreign currency and repatriated within the statutory period (generally 180 days from export declaration); (4) genuine input VAT special invoices are held for purchased materials; (5) the export tax refund filing is on record and monthly export refund reports are filed on the Electronic Tax Bureau; and (6) the goods are not on a prohibition/refund-exclusion list. The refund is capped by the input VAT legally attributable to the exported goods that remains after offset against domestic output VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration Form (出口货物报关单, export-refund designation)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (海运提单/空运运单)
Foreign exchange collection evidence (bank inward remittance advice credited to the SAFE-monitored trade account)
Export sales contract or purchase order
Special VAT invoices for input purchases (增值税专用发票) and procurement contracts
SAFE Trade in Foreign Exchange Registry entry (贸易外汇收支企业名录登记)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export refund claims are audited under the STA–GACC–SAFE joint data platform and 'anti-fraud' campaigns. Failure to collect export proceeds within 180 days of export declaration, absent one of the nine statutory exceptional circumstances, recharacterizes the export as a deemed domestic sale (视同内销) requiring supplementary output VAT, forfeiture of the refund, daily late-payment surcharges at 0.05%, and penalties under the Tax Administration Law. Document forgery or fraudulent over-claiming exposes the WFOE to an administrative clawback of the refunded tax and a penalty of 50%–500% of the tax defrauded; criminal prosecution under Article 204 of the Criminal Law (骗取出口退税罪) attaches where the fraud exceeds RMB 50,000, with imprisonment escalating from up to 5 years to life imprisonment for aggravated amounts above RMB 2,500,000, alongside fines of 1–5 times the defrauded tax and asset forfeiture.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC), acting through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), is the monetary and foreign-exchange authority for the mainland-incorporated WFOE. The Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission and Central Bank of Taiwan do not regulate the onshore banking or FX position of this CN-WFOE.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: RMB is convertible for current-account transactions such as cross-border trade in goods, service fees and ordinary profit remittances, subject to genuine transaction documentation and bank authenticity review. Capital-account transactions remain regulated: inbound FDI equity injection requires an FDI foreign-exchange registration with SAFE, disbursement into a designated capital settlement account, and post-settlement declaration of use. Dividend/profit remittance to the Taiwan shareholder is treated as investment income under the current account only after the WFOE has completed its statutory audit, paid or settled corporate income tax, and allocated the statutory surplus reserve at 10 percent of after-tax profits until the reserve reaches 50 percent of registered capital. The remitting bank requires the audited financial statements, CIT payment vouchers, board resolution and the relevant SAFE report; the RMB amount is converted into USD and remitted via SWIFT MT103 under BOP purpose code 322011. Liquidation proceeds, shareholder loans and outward guarantees require separate capital-account approvals or registrations and are not freely remittable.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE's goods-trade foreign-exchange administration regime (SAFE Order [2012] No. 1 as amended), export proceeds must be received into the WFOE's domestic current-account foreign-currency account and reconciled with Customs export declarations. There is no mandatory conversion ratio or forced surrender requirement for ordinary manufactured exports; the WFOE may retain USD export earnings or convert them to RMB at the onshore interbank rate. The SAFE monitoring system applies a deferred-collection reporting threshold of 180 days after Customs export declaration: if the underlying payment terms exceed 180 days, the bank must record the transaction in the goods-trade monitoring system and obtain the required deferred-receipt registration before settlement. For exports to Taiwan, the receiving bank will match the incoming SWIFT credit against the Customs declaration ID, export invoice, packing list and transport documents.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low for substantive onshore statutory flows. Offshore digital EMI/e-money platforms cannot open a compliant RMB current account, receive export proceeds, or hold the WFOE's FDI capital settlement account. Such platforms may provide offshore collection convenience for overseas distributors, but funds must still be repatriated through a SAFE-licensed onshore bank to satisfy goods-trade FX verification. Routing statutory export proceeds through an offshore EMI without a domestic underlying bank creates false-trade red flags, AML/SAR exposure and SAFE enforcement risk. The WFOE should use licensed onshore banks as the only clearing channel for trade, capital and treasury flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person onboarding is mandatory for a newly incorporated PRC company. The legal representative and each natural-person beneficial owner holding 25 percent or more equity, or otherwise exercising ultimate control, must attend a physical KYC/UBO interview at the chosen bank branch in mainland China. Remote video interview may be used as a supplementary check but not as a full substitute. If the legal representative is a Taiwan resident unable to travel, the bank generally accepts a notarized and authenticated power of attorney combined with physical attendance of the local finance officer; however, many Tier-1 banks still require at least one director of the WFOE to appear in person in the first account-opening meeting. Fully remote account opening for a WFOE is not permitted under PBOC account-opening rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk nexus identified because the Taiwan shareholder, beneficial owner or counterparty has tax residency in or transactions routed through a FATF grey-listed or high-risk jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Passport and corporate registration extracts, group structure chart, beneficial-ownership register, sanctions and PEP screening reports, FATCA/CRS self-certifications, board resolutions, source-of-wealth statement, bank reference letters, and evidence of Taiwan MOEA/FSC filing where applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Goods-flow mismatch between the declared surgical suture needle assembly scope and the value, volume, currency or transport route of trade payments, especially small high-value parcels.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Customs export declarations, bills of lading, airway bills, packing lists, warehouse receipts, ISO 13485 certificate, medical-device registration certificates for the Chinese market, CE or FDA or TFDA certificates as applicable, production batch records, quality inspection reports, and order-to-payment contract chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Related-party or triangular payment pattern involving advance payments, Hong Kong or offshore EMI settlement, or intercompany funding before verifiable operating history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Intercompany agreements, transfer-pricing documentation or local file, board minutes proving commercial substance, pro-forma invoices, full PO-to-payment reconciliation, inventory records, logistics tracking, bank statements, and SAFE goods-trade monitoring declarations matching goods flow to payment flow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid FX round-tripping or unusual dividend/capital movement within the first 12 months without matching business operations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements, management accounts, 12-month cash-flow forecast, VAT and CIT returns, payroll and social-insurance records, lease agreements, equipment and raw-material purchase invoices, inventory and production evidence, and tax clearance certificates.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity injection from the Taiwan shareholder must be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the direct investor's own corporate bank account to the WFOE's designated FDI capital settlement account at a SAFE-licensed onshore bank. The remitter name must match the entity recorded in the SAFE FDI registration; third-party payments are not permitted. The wire should state 'Equity injection into registered capital of CN_WFOE_LTD' and use BOP transaction code 621011 for new foreign direct investment. TWD is not a freely deliverable onshore clearing currency; the Taiwan shareholder should remit USD or CNH/RMB via CIPS or a corresponding Taiwan RMB clearing bank. After crediting, the onshore bank verifies the FDI registration certificate and may convert the foreign currency into RMB for permitted operating purposes. Each settlement must be supported by a capital-proceeds payment-use declaration, and the WFOE may not use the funds for prohibited uses such as securities investment, entrusted lending or real estate beyond scope.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For export of surgical suture needles and assemblies from mainland China to Taiwan distributors or end customers, use SWIFT MT103 TT settlement with BOP purpose code 121010 for general-trade export collection. The bank must receive the Customs declaration number, commercial invoice, packing list and transport documents, and the recipient name must match the trade counterparty. For import of PGA resin, surgical needles, packaging materials or capital equipment, the WFOE may open a commercial letter of credit via SWIFT MT700/MT707, requiring documents such as commercial invoice, bill of lading, packing list, origin certificate, insurance certificate and quality certificate. For cross-border RMB trade with Taiwan, the WFOE may clear via CIPS through an onshore designated bank if the Taiwan counterparty participates through a RMB clearing bank. All outbound trade payments must be recorded in the SAFE goods-trade monitoring system and must correspond to genuine import contracts.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable RMB/USD FX forwards based on genuine export or import contracts, with a maturity matching expected trade cash flows and no speculative open position.
RMB/USD or RMB/TWD FX swaps where the WFOE has simultaneous export and import settlement cycles, executed with a SAFE-licensed onshore bank under real-demand documentation.

Cross-currency swaps (RMB/USD) for long-term USD cash flows arising from a SAFE-registered external borrowing facility or major imported-equipment contract, with ISDA documentation and bank credit approval.
Onshore FX option structures and collars on confirmed current-account exposures, provided no naked option writing and no speculative leverage.

Offshore CNH non-deliverable forwards are not permissible for the PRC WFOE itself; the Taiwan parent may, on its own books and with segregated capital, use an offshore CNH NDF as a separate treasury hedge, but such NDF cannot be commingled with the WFOE's onshore FX exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual income tax return and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Taiwan Ministry of Finance, National Taxation Bureau with jurisdiction over the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally May 1–May 31 for the preceding fiscal year; confirm any extension or special filing rule with the competent tax office.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or payment may result in tax penalties, interest, and assessment. The authority may pursue collection; no automatic corporate strike-off is triggered solely by a late tax return.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders’ meeting and approval of financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No routine filing authority; meeting records and approved statements are maintained by the company, subject to applicable filing or inspection requirements.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a company with a calendar fiscal year, generally within six months after year-end; the articles of incorporation and applicable company-law rules govern.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene or approve accounts may expose responsible persons to statutory penalties and shareholder claims. It does not by itself trigger automatic strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual report on company directors, managers, and shareholders holding more than 10% of shares
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs or its designated company-information reporting platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally July 1–July 31 each year; report changes within the separate statutory period where applicable.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-reporting or inaccurate reporting may result in fines and orders to correct. Repeated noncompliance may lead to further statutory enforcement; no automatic strike-off deadline applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual business tax return and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Taiwan Ministry of Finance, National Taxation Bureau with jurisdiction over the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally filed every two months, by the 15th day of the following period; this is a recurring obligation rather than a single annual return.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or payment may result in fines, interest, and tax assessment or collection. No automatic corporate strike-off is triggered solely by delinquency.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders; publicly listed or regulated issuers also report to the competent securities regulator and market operators
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For companies subject to securities reporting, generally within four months after fiscal year-end, subject to applicable securities rules; not a general filing requirement for every private company.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: For covered issuers, late or deficient reporting may result in regulatory sanctions, fines, trading measures, or other enforcement. This requirement does not generally apply to an ordinary private company.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Taiwan company-law requirements may require CPA-audited financial statements when prescribed capital, revenue, asset, or regulated-activity thresholds are met. Thresholds and exceptions depend on company type and current implementing rules; verify against the company’s paid-in capital, annual revenue, total assets, and industry-specific licensing conditions. Public companies and certain regulated businesses are subject to separate audit requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan generally accepted accounting principles apply to private companies, subject to applicable company-law requirements. Taiwan-IFRS requirements apply to specified public companies and other entities within the mandatory adoption rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan companies generally submit the annual company-information report covering directors, managers, and shareholders holding more than 10% of shares. This is not a general annual confirmation of all beneficial ownership or every share transfer. Record share transfers in the company’s shareholder register and report relevant information or changes within applicable statutory deadlines. Taiwan does not have a general public UBO register equivalent to some jurisdictions’ central beneficial-ownership registers.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Supervisors, where applicable
Minute Book and shareholders’ meeting records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 0–2,000 annually; Taiwan does not generally require a registered agent, and any office or service-provider fee is commercial rather than a statutory renewal fee.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000–15,000 for a typical private-company audit; actual fees depend on size, transaction volume, industry, and audit scope. No audit fee is mandatory where no statutory or contractual audit applies.
